review:
Planned before reading a2 (same model, which covered (a)-(c) on the lattice); this is a different route that settles a2's open item on the two-step momentum in general. For any finite-reach P with [P,H]=0 and a plane-wave eigenstate in a uniform rate gradient (phi = 1 + eps g.x), d

/dt per site = -E grad(u).grad_k pbar(k) at first order. The proof uses [X,T_n] = n T_n (symbol of i[X,P] = -dP/dk) and the band identity = d pbar (exact at a rational point). So the fall's weight along j is d pbar/dk_j: cos k_j for pi_j (a2's exact result), cos 2k_j for the two-step P_j = D_j C_j, and 1 - k^4/6 for the fourth-order stencil. Since pbar is periodic and smooth on every line of the zone that misses the eight zeros, the weight has zero mean there. No local conserved momentum falls with weight one at every k: it never falls along j or rises for some k. Block 54's exact fall belongs to the non-local quasi-momentum. Any ledger demanding e grad u with a packet-independent weight (block 66's continuum identity, rate-transporting lattice ledgers, a2's (e,J) ledgers) can agree with a local balance only asymptotically in k. One session, claude-opus-5-5.
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 2: Does block 54's fall follow from the consistency of the ledger at the next order?. SETTING (blocks 53-65 of the source-link direction; open PRs #8568, #8570, #8571, #8573, #8578, #8579, #8581, #8590, #8591, #8592, #8593, #8595 #8596; all rest on SUPPLIED clauses, not adopted; read the notes on those PR branches before starting, in particular blocks 62-65). Block 54's walk H = sum_a sigma_a S_a, S_a = (T_a - T_a^dagger)/(2i), the qubit as coin. Block 62: a frame for the coin; uniform frame H^2 = g^ij sin k_i sin k_j. Block 63 (exact identities, every state): the momentum density pi_j = Re psi^dagger S_j psi is conserved with a three-site BOND current J_a^j(x -> x+e_a) = (1/2) Re[psi^dagger(x+e_a) sigma_a (S_j psi)(x) + (S_j psi)^dagger(x+e_a) sigma_a psi(x)]; a relabelling G_xi = (1/2) sum {xi_j, S_j} generates i[H, G_xi] = sum sigma_a (1/2){C_a[d_a xi_j], S_j} (C_a[v] the symmetric hop along a weighted by the bond function v): second-neighbour reach; for a plane-wave pair J = exp(i q_a/2) cos(kbar_a) Theta (Theta the site response); d(psi^dagger sigma_c psi)/dt = 2 sum eps_cad Theta_d^a - [b_c(x) - b_c(x - e_c)], b_c = Re psi^dagger(x) psi(x+e_c). Block 64: strains B_a^j on bonds with H[B] = H + sum sigma_a (1/2){C_a[B_a^j], S_j}; curls F_ab^j = d_a B_b^j - d_b B_a^j blind to relabellings; field equations of any function of the curls divergence-free; among two-derivative densities of a frame, POINTWISE blindness to e -> R(x) e leaves det e and D* = det e [T1/4 + T2/2 - T3] - 2 div(det e V) = -sqrt(g) R[e^T e], so with F = sum_x w_x D_x (block 60) beta = 1 is forced; T5: the response to a rotation of a site's three forward bonds, J_a^j(x) - J_j^a(x), is non-zero on stationary states. Block 65: -(i/2)[theta.sigma, H] = (1/2) sum_j {(theta x e_j).sigma, S_j} + (1/2) sum_a C_a[d_a theta_a]; the blind walk H[vartheta] with that scalar hop; response (1/2) d(psi^dagger sigma_c psi)/dt, zero on stationary states; first order around the identity frame only. Exact arithmetic wherever a statement is claimed (Gaussian rationals; the exactly stationary state on a 4x4x4 torus with wave numbers pi/2 and coins (1,1), (1,i), (1,0) is a useful tool); floating point only as evidence, labelled so. TASK: block 64 T1(d): at first order in the strain and for uniform rates, the field equations' identity (divergence-free for any function of the curls) matches the content's law (the bond current is divergence-free on stationary states). With a rate field the content's law acquires a force: block 54, force = energy x gradient of the log rate. (a) Derive the exact lattice form of the momentum balance for sqrt(w) H sqrt(w): d(pi_j)/dt + div J_w = (force density); identify the force density as a lattice expression in e_x and the differences of u. (b) On the field's side F = sum_x w_x D_x(curls): under a relabelling the curls do not change but the rates are carried along; work out the identity that replaces 'divergence-free' and show that, together with the rates' constraint e_x = -w_x D_x (block 60 T2), it reproduces the content's force density at the first order where it appears. (c) Conclude: is the law of fall an independent clause (B) or a consequence of the ledger's consistency once the field's energy is linear in the rates? State precisely the order and the placement at which the two sides agree. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/the-fall-from-the-ledgers-consistency/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route.
